newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT-Flemings cuts Kimberly-Clark Mexico.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT-Flemings cuts Kimberly-Clark Mexico.

text.p: - Flemings Research cuts Kimberly-Clark de Mexico from long-term buy to hold.

- Analyst Terry Sigler says share price should stagnate following weak Q4 1996 results. "We believe that Kimberly-Clark de Mexico's (Kimber) share price which has appreciated about 22 percent in local terms (18 percent in dollar terms) since we recommended the stock in September should move in line with the bolsa following weaker than expected Q4 earnings."
- Kimber released preliminary results which indicate continued price deterioration, only modest volume gains and possible market share erosion.
- Flemings said the stock remains an attractive core holding, though.
